svg.title: At desktop width only the table that never fit changes
svg.desc: Two crops of /terms at 1440px. Before, the 1051px table spilled past its 940px content column and the Reference column sat outside the content edge. After, it scrolls inside the column with an edge shadow marking the hidden column. Other directories fit their column and do not scroll. The table header was already stuck underneath the topbar, so the scroller loses nothing visible.
svg.text: At desktop width only the table that never fit changes
/terms at 1440px: its 1051px table is wider than the 940px content column

g.text: scrolls inside the column; edge shadow on the right
Background gradients that move with the
content show a shadow only on a side that
still has columns to scroll to.
A scroller stops the sticky table header
following the page. But it stuck at top 0,
under the 44px sticky topbar: scrolled down,
it was never visible. Nothing a reader saw
is lost; a visible sticky header is separate
fits its column at 1440px: table width
equals region width, so nothing scrolls.
